title: Normally Optimised
description: Optimised and Cartoony that's kind a it
body:
### The Best Way to Play Minecraft: Fast & Fun.

**Normally Optimised** is a lightweight, performance-focused modpack that bridges the gap between raw power and a charming, stylized visual experience. Designed for players who want to keep the "vanilla" feel while ensuring their game runs butter-smooth on any hardware.

**Why choose Normally Optimised?**

* **Vulkan Accelerated:** By integrating the **Vulkanmod**, we have overhauled the rendering engine to provide significant FPS boosts, reduced stuttering, and better compatibility across modern systems.
* **Cartoony Aesthetic:** Say goodbye to dull textures. We’ve curated a collection of vibrant, clean, and cartoony visual enhancements that make every block and mob pop with personality.
* **Optimized Performance:** Every mod in this pack is hand-picked to minimize bloat. You get a faster game, better frame times, and a polished look—nothing more, nothing less.

**Perfect for players who want a smooth, snappy experience that looks as good as it performs.**

---

*Note: This pack does not include shaders. And some mods here will get you banned or warned if you in a competitive pvp server. Some mods here are olso for building.*
